dataset_info.authoring: Drafted blind by separate agents from README, tool schemas and catalog only; labels not reviewed by a human
dataset_info.owner_label_review: none: not reviewed by a human
dataset_info.split: dev part: used to find and fix problems
dataset_info.split_rule: stratified by category; within a category the first third by sha256('leadgate-fresh6-2026-11-20'+id) is dev, the rest is test
